name: drawing_exports_to_pdf
why: ENTRY Z-C6. `set_sheet`, `model_view` and `export_pdf` are in the catalogue with `Tested = true` and until 24/9/2026 only a hand-written plan touched them (`dwg_3_sheet`, `dwg_5_isometric`, `dwg_7_pdf`): a note of how it was measured once, which runs in no run and demands nothing. This case lines them up on a real drawing and demands from each one thing that can go wrong silently.

expect.why: 120 x 80 x 10: if this does not add up, the drawing below is of another part
a view attaches to the FILE of the part: without saving it there is nothing to put on the drawing
from here on the steps measure the drawing, not the part
one sheet: it is the number the last step compares the pages of the PDF with

THE SCALE RE-READ FROM THE SHEET, not repeated from the argument: the operation refuses if the sheet says otherwise, and here we look that the re-reading reached the answer. A drawing in the wrong scale prints all the same and every dimension read with a ruler is false.

the projection angle is NOT decided here: it is re-read from the drawing template of the workshop and rewritten the same. If this line said «third», `SetProperties2` would have flipped the drawing without an error

expect.tolerance_why: A3 is 420 x 297 by the standard; the tenth covers the rounding to one decimal of the answer

expect.why: ONE view, counted by the operation after the call: `CreateDrawViewFromModelView3` returns just `null` when the name is wrong, and without counting it would look like a drawing that does not want the isometric
THE TWO READINGS AGREE: the operation says one, the state re-read from scratch finds one

the name came from the first level of the SOLIDWORKS-language converter, what the view does when shown, and not from the table of the names: a first level that finds nothing would otherwise be rescued by the table and the case would stay green

the TRUE name with which SOLIDWORKS accepted it (`*Isometric` in English, the Italian word on the installation it was measured on): it is the fact the operation declares so that next time it is written instead of remembered
the text that the last step must FIND AGAIN in the PDF (entry GT3-bis)
`export_pdf` without a path puts the PDF next to the drawing: a drawing never saved has no «next to»

ENTRY GT3-bis: the note written two steps earlier comes out of the PDF as TEXT. Measured with `Checks/PdfText`: in the file it is written as glyph indices behind the /ToUnicode tables, and a search in the bytes would not find it — `export_pdf` decodes it
THE RED IN THE SAME RUN: a text that is not in the drawing must NOT be found. Without this line, a decoder that «finds» everything would pass the line above

THE PAGES ARE COUNTED IN THE FILE WRITTEN, not copied from the sheets: `CountPdfPages` opens the PDF and counts the objects «/Type /Page». It is the measure that catches the PDF of a single sheet when the drawing has three -- the defect this operation exists for
next to the drawing, with its name: it is where whoever looks for it goes to look
